summary: Draft a form, email, or support request from information on this private webpage, fill it in, and show me exactly what will be submitted before I approve it.
note: HALF SHIPPED — kept open for the half that does not exist. The "fill it in and show exactly what will be sent" half is covered well by local-agent/formFill.js (cap-1e04349c / cap-75ee1730 / cap-28eaa582, implemented): POST /forms/fill returns a manifest with willSend {method, submitsTo, enctype, fields}, a literal rendered request preview, submit.clicked:false, missingRequired, and password fields structurally left unfilled. MISSING: (1) the "from information on this private webpage" half does not exist — fillForm requires caller-supplied values and there is no read-page-A then compose-values-for-form-B step anywhere; (2) no email or support-request variant — parseFormHtml walks <form> markup only, so a web-mail contenteditable compose surface will not parse, and send_email is Mail.app-only; (3) not reachable outside HTTP — there is no fill_form executor action and no planner entry, so neither voice nor a routine can invoke it.
